newsitem.title: USA: Manor Care board approves lodging spin-off.
newsitem.headline: Manor Care board approves lodging spin-off.

text.p: Manor Care Inc said on Tuesday its board of directors approved a tax free spin-off of its lodging business to shareholders of record on October 10.
The company said in a statement it was separating the lodging division from its health care business to improve capital-raising efficiency.
November 1 is the distribution date, it said.
Manor Care shareholders will receive one share of the stock of the new lodging company, to be named Choice Hotels International, the company said.
The separation would give Choice Hotels direct access to the capital markets and permit it to raise funds on the basis of its own operating profile, the company said.

The company also said its board declared a cash dividend of $0.022 per share for the second quarter of fiscal 1997, payable on November 27 to shareholders of record on November 15. The company said the lodging business had revenues of $395 milion for the 12 months ended August 31.
